Thanks for the idea. One honest note before you write: Linerave is a
personal fork, maintained by one person for their own use. Suggestions
are genuinely welcome and do get read — a few of the app's best features
started as requests — but not everything suggested will be built, and
there's no roadmap schedule. Big open-ended ideas often fit better in
Discussions, if they're enabled on this repo.
